title: Gnossienne No. 1
video_use_ideas: Underscore a puzzle, a night walk, or an uneasy pause.
legal_notes: Composition published 1893, so the music itself is PD-EU and PD-US. The Mutopia edition (piece 2035) is Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0, stated on the piece page and in the LilyPond header. Share-alike can obligate a derivative edition, and a render made from this specific edition should not be treated as a clean PD recording. Credit the typesetter via the Mutopia page if this file is shipped. Preview is an own FluidSynth render.

title: Gymnopédie No. 1
video_use_ideas: Bed a still portrait or a slow text card.
legal_notes: Composition published Paris 1888. PD-EU (Satie d.1925, life+70 from 1996) and PD-US. Mutopia piece 37 and the LilyPond header say Public Domain. The Commons recording is the uploader's own file under the CC0 1.0 deed (waive rights worldwide, including neighboring rights, commercial use allowed). Sample rate is only 22.05 kHz, so the PD MIDI remains the cleaner editable source if a higher-rate render is needed. Preview is cut from the CC0 recording.

title: Erlkönig
video_use_ideas: Create tension with the galloping piano introduction.
recording_performer: Michael Jackson (as credited on source page)
legal_notes: Composition PD-EU (life+70 expired) and PD-US (historic published work). Recording CC BY 3.0: credit Michael Jackson exactly as the source names him, link the source and https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/, and state edits. Do not identify him as the pop singer. Goethe text (d.1832) is PD; PD score permits an alternative own render without recording attribution.

title: Träumerei

recording_performer: Musopen (performer not named on source page)
legal_notes: Composition PD-EU (life+70 expired) and PD-US (historic published work). Recording explicitly PD release by Musopen with VRT ticket 2008012110017088. Source asks courtesy attribution; credit Musopen (https://musopen.org/) is recommended. Performer not identified on source page. PD editable edition also downloaded.

title: Vltava (The Moldau)
video_use_ideas: A widening landscape or a company story that gathers speed.
legal_notes: Symphonic poem 1874, composition PD. Archive.org item MusopenCollectionAsFlac describes the 2012 Musopen Kickstarter recordings as purchased and released into the public domain, and the item license URL is the Creative Commons Public Domain Mark 1.0. The description names Smetana - Vltava. The same recording's Commons OGG (File:Smetana, Má vlast - Vltava - The Moldau.ogg) is tagged CC0. Local file is the 24-bit FLAC from that archive item.

title: Radetzky March
video_use_ideas: Punch in a crowd, a countdown, or a victory beat.
recording_performer: United States Marine Band, Col. John R. Bourgeois (album Sound Off, 1992)
legal_notes: This march is by Johann Strauss I (d.1849), not Johann Strauss II. Composition PD. Commons license tag is {{PD-USMC}}, which redirects to PD-USGov-Military-Marines: official-duty U.S. Marine work, public domain as a work of the U.S. federal government. Foreign status of U.S. government works varies. Page credits the 1992 album Sound Off.

title: On the Beautiful Blue Danube
video_use_ideas: Glide through a city night montage or a celebration cut.
legal_notes: Waltz composed 1866, PD-EU and PD-US. Recording file page: composition tag PD-old-auto-expired (death year 1899) and performance tag PD-USGov-Military-Marines (U.S. federal government work, public domain in the United States). Foreign recognition of U.S. government works varies. The Mutopia MIDI (piece 519) is only the main theme and is CC BY-SA 4.0; do not treat that edition as a clean PD score. Preview is cut from the Marine Band FLAC, not from the MIDI.

title: Light Cavalry Overture

legal_notes: Overture 1866. Composer d.1895, composition PD. Foreign recognition of U.S. government recordings varies. Preview is the early allegro, not the slow middle section.
